breakdown.description: The name-consistency check mixes the `Mg_Ga` charge-state group with a Ga-vacancy reference entry.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification checks defect_name_consistency only across the Mg_Ga charge-state group entries, without mixing in a Ga-vacancy reference entry. This aligns with the ground truth, which only uses Mg_Ga substitution entries for charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1] and does not include any Ga-vacancy reference entry in the consistency check.
